channel.title: Viral Mia Kitchen
channel.description: Tested 15-minute weeknight dinners, viral air fryer favorites, cozy comfort food, and money-saving kitchen hacks made with everyday US grocery staples.

item.title: Crispy Baked Tortilla Pizza That Bakes in Under 10 Minutes
item.description: Make a crispy baked tortilla pizza in under 10 minutes with this foolproof recipe. Perfect for busy weeknights, movie nights, and fast family dinners.

item.title: 10-Minute Greek Chickpea Salad with Tangy Feta Dressing
item.description: Crisp cucumbers, creamy garbanzos, and a fast emulsified feta dressing. Learn the moisture-control secret that keeps this lunch salad crunchy for days.

item.title: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Steak Bites That Beat a $25 Steakhouse Plate
item.description: Make tender air fryer steak bites at home for $3.50 a serving. Drenched in rich herbed garlic butter, this quick 10-minute dinner beats takeout.

item.title: How to Clean a Cast Iron Skillet Without Ruining the Seasoning
item.description: Learn how to clean a cast iron skillet safely using warm water, kosher salt, and zero soap damage. Master proper maintenance for lasting non-stick pans.

item.title: The Mac and Cheese My Family Requests Every Single Sunday
item.description: A reliable, ultra-creamy baked macaroni and cheese recipe with a sharp cheddar blend and a crispy panko crust. The ultimate crowd-pleaser for your next dinner.

item.title: The Science of 2-Ingredient Bagels: Why Strained Yogurt Changes Everything
item.description: Master the high-protein bagel with this kitchen-tested guide. Learn how the acid in Greek yogurt reacts with leavening for a chewy, no-yeast crumb in 25 minutes.

item.title: Stop Wasting Produce: The Exact Foil Trick for Crisp Celery and Carrots
item.description: Learn how to store celery and carrots so they stay crisp and fresh for a whole month. Skip plastic bags and use this simple aluminum foil kitchen hack.

item.title: Crispy Air Fryer Sweet Potato Cubes (Garlic Herb Crunch on a Budget)
item.description: Crispy air fryer sweet potato cubes tossed in garlic herb seasoning. Easy, budget-friendly 15-minute side dish for under 85 cents a serving.

item.title: 15-Minute Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry That Beats the Delivery Fee
item.description: Skip the $38 takeout bill. This easy beef and broccoli stir fry takes 15 minutes in one hot skillet with tender flank steak and a glossy savory sauce.

item.title: How to Keep Cut Apples from Turning Brown in Lunchboxes Without Lemon Juice
item.description: Learn how to keep cut apples from browning using a simple kitchen soak that preserves crisp texture and flavor without tasting like citrus. Perfect for kids' school lunches.

item.title: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
item.description: Make this rich, comforting creamy chicken wild rice soup in a single Dutch oven. Minimal cleanup, cozy textures, and ready in under 45 minutes.

item.title: Rich & Fudgy 5-Minute Microwave Mug Brownie for Late-Night Cravings
item.description: Cure your late-night chocolate craving in minutes. This fudgy microwave mug brownie is rich, gooey, and made with simple pantry staples.

item.title: One-Pan Creamy Pesto Chicken and Penne
item.description: Make creamy pesto chicken pasta in just one pan with zero boiling required. Skip the $35 DoorDash fee and eat in under twenty minutes tonight.

item.title: 15-Minute Lemon Herb Butter Shrimp Skillet (One Pan!)
item.description: Make this 15-minute lemon herb butter shrimp skillet in a single pan for a fast, no-fuss weeknight dinner loaded with garlic and citrus flavor.

item.title: How to Chop an Onion Without Crying Once (The $0 Science Hack)
item.description: Stop tearing up every dinner prep! Here is the simple science-backed trick to chop onions without crying, using tools you already have at home.

item.title: Better Than The Freezer Aisle: My Crispy Air Fryer French Toast Sticks
item.description: Ditch the soggy microwave sticks! These air fryer french toast sticks are perfectly golden, crisp on the edges, and soft inside. Ready in under 15 minutes.

item.title: The Lazy Girl Guide to Silky Slow Cooker Potato Leek Soup
item.description: Forget standing over a hot stove. This slow cooker potato leek soup uses a simple starch trick for a velvety texture without the constant stirring.

item.title: The $0 Rice Hack: Why I Put Ice Cubes in My Microwave (And Saved $25)
item.description: Stop eating crunchy leftover rice! Use Mia's simple ice cube trick to reheat rice in the microwave for fluffy results every time. Save money on takeout tonight.

item.title: 15-Minute Loaded Black Bean Taco Bowls (When You Refuse to Do Dishes)
item.description: Fast, flavorful, and zero sink pileup. These easy black bean taco bowls whip up in 15 minutes using canned beans, warm spices, and pantry staples.

item.title: Grandma’s 25-Minute Fluffy Buttermilk Biscuits (Under $3 a Batch!)
item.description: Skip the pricey brunch takeout! These fluffy buttermilk biscuits bake up golden and sky-high in 25 minutes using budget-friendly pantry staples.

item.title: I Almost Ruined My Favorite Pot: How to Clean Burnt Pots with $1 Pantry Staples
item.description: Stop scrubbing! Learn how to clean burnt pots using baking soda and vinegar. Save $40 on new cookware with this $0.30 frugal Aldi pantry hack.

item.title: Forget Soggy Veggies: These Crispy Air Fryer Green Bean Fries Are My New Obsession
item.description: Skip the greasy potato fries! These air fryer green beans are ultra-crunchy, perfectly seasoned, and paired with a zesty garlic aioli. Quick, easy, and healthy.

item.title: How to Store Carrots and Celery in Water So They Stay Insanely Crisp for 4 Weeks
item.description: Stop throwing away limp veggies! Here is how to store carrots and celery in water to keep them crunchy and fresh for up to a full month of holiday cooking.

item.title: Cozy Apple & Pear Crisp with Golden Oat Crunch
item.description: Make this easy apple crisp in under 30 minutes! Sweet apples, juicy pears, and a buttery oat topping create the ultimate cozy weeknight comfort food.

item.title: One-Pan Creamy Tuscan Gnocchi: Ready in 15 Minutes
item.description: Skip the sink full of dishes with this 15-minute creamy tuscan gnocchi. Crispy potato pillows swimming in a garlicky parmesan sauce. Totally foolproof.
